en.headline: Police seize HK$210,000 of drugs in Yau Ma Tei flat, arrest 11
en.dek: Yau Tsim officers raided a Man Ming Lane unit on Tuesday, recovering suspected methamphetamine, heroin, cocaine and midazolam tablets; a 56-year-old woman was held for operating a drug den.
body: Police in the Yau Tsim district carried out an anti-narcotics operation on Tuesday and searched a flat on Man Ming Lane in Yau Ma Tei, recovering about 283 grams of suspected methamphetamine, around 100 grams of suspected heroin, roughly 22 grams of suspected cocaine and about 50 tablets believed to be midazolam, together with drug-taking paraphernalia including aluminium foil and lighters.

The seized drugs had an estimated street value of about HK$210,000. A 56-year-old local woman found inside the premises was arrested on suspicion of operating a drug den and trafficking in dangerous drugs.

Ten other people in the flat — six men, three women and one mainland woman aged between 46 and 67 — were detained on suspicion of consuming or injecting dangerous drugs. All eleven suspects remained in custody for further enquiries as officers examined the source of the narcotics.

zh.headline: 油麻地文明里毒窟檢值21萬毒品 拘11人
zh.dek: 油尖警方周二突擊搜查文明里單位，檢獲懷疑冰毒、海洛英、可卡因及藍精靈，56歲女子涉經營毒窟及販運被捕。
body: 油尖警區人員根據線報及深入調查，於周二在油麻地文明里一個單位進行突擊搜查，檢獲約283克懷疑冰毒、約100克懷疑海洛英、約22克懷疑可卡因、約50粒懷疑咪達唑侖（俗稱藍精靈），以及紙巾、打火機等懷疑吸毒工具。
檢獲毒品估計市值約21萬元。單位內一名56歲本地女子涉嫌經營毒窟及販運危險藥物被捕。
單位內另外六名本地男子、三名本地女子及一名內地女子，年齡介乎46至67歲，涉嫌服食或注射危險藥物被捕。十一名被捕人現正被扣留調查，警方繼續追查毒品來源。
